basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Applied AI Engineer | Production LLM Agents | Evals, Memory & Tools
basics.summary: Applied AI engineer who turns model capability into products that hold up in real use. Currently Lead AI Engineer at LumApps, shipping production multi-agent systems on GCP that 2x outbound conversions and forecast $1M in quarterly revenue. I own AI features end to end: prompts, tools, memory, evals, tracing, cost and latency tuning. 13+ years shipping software to 10M+ users, including an LLM pipeline that eliminated $337K in vendor cost at Beekeeper and foundational neural network and evolutionary AI research at EPFL. Zurich-based, product-minded, ship-test-refine by default.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Shipped production multi-agent workflows for outbound sales on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI. ReAct, self-reflection and hierarchical delegation; tools exposed over MCP; agent state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. Raw model output shaped into structured, dependable actions with verification loops and human-in-the-loop draft-before-send. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day, forecast $1M in quarterly revenue.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes. Event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub, per-agent query and write-back contracts, and a freshness layer that flags stale facts to ground RAG and cut hallucinations.

Owned end-to-end: agent architecture, eval pipelines that reflect real usage, LangSmith tracing across model, orchestration, and infra layers, tool-selection tuning, and cost-per-request instrumentation. Tuned live systems for speed, cost, and reliability; on-call for global production.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline built in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated, product team iterates without external gatekeepers. Evals and prompt tuning to keep quality on par with human vendors.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist giving every new signup personalized, high-touch guidance at scale. 100% of customers guided through setup, time-to-first-value reduced without adding headcount.
Built GenAI demo system for sales. Auto-generates personalized content from Salesforce data so every pitch feels custom-built. Improved demo speed and close rates.

Ran observability and global on-call (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io) with logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting; diagnosed and fixed production issues at the source across model, service, and infra layers.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL). 500+ successful deliveries, every flight a live UX test for autonomous systems in the real world.
Engineered real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization algorithms. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and neural controllers via genetic algorithms. Rare research direction where morphology and neural control evolve together through artificial selection.

Migrated the simulation and training pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research, work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Foundational ML experience (optimization, search, fitness landscapes, neural controller training) that informs how I approach modern LLM and agentic systems today.

AI agents generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data, with explainability and evaluation built in: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship. Now serving live users on real-time feeds.

RAG-grounded assistant answers DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions in plain language with citations back to the regulation; compliance-first agentic design flags risk before users file. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Applied AI Engineer, Zurich (Permanent). Recruiter: AP Group Ltd / AP Executive. Client is a growing tech business applying modern AI models to everyday tasks. Small senior team. Role: take AI capability and turn it into working product for end users, spanning ML, engineering, and product. Responsibilities: ship AI-driven features end to end, design prompts/tools/memory/workflows for agents, convert raw model output into structured/dependable/predictable, trace and fix across stack, tune for speed/cost/reliability, build practical evals, work with product and engineering. Stack: Python, PyTorch/JAX, LLMs (commercial APIs and open-weight), model serving/inference infra, vector databases. Looking for: solid ML grounding, direct experience training/fine-tuning/deploying models, clean production code, comfort moving between model/infra/product layers, sound judgement, ship-test-refine mindset.
